articleTitle: Structural Model of an Innovative Information System for Prevention and Detection of Financial Customs Violations
publicationTitle: 2020 III International Conference on High Technology for Sustainable Development (HiTech)
abstract: The article describes the design of a system for detecting financial customs violations using the methods of artificial intelligence. The information is collected automatically from heterogeneous databases of different institutions and stored in a data center. At the output of the system, hypotheses are generated, indicated with the respective probabilities concerning past, present or future customs violations. The result of the work, the intervention of the operators and the actions of the customs officers are recorded and stored according to the block-chain technology. The system is designed in such a way as to control the actions of the human operator, which makes any external intervention very difficult or impossible. The efficiency of knowledge extraction to generate hypotheses is guaranteed by the use of combination of various AI methods.

articleTitle: Exploring Interoperability of Blockchain Technology and the Possibility of Collaboration with the Existing Information Systems of the Enterprises
publicationTitle: 2020 III International Conference on High Technology for Sustainable Development (HiTech)
abstract: Blockchain technology is information technology that provokes research in various scientific fields, including information technology, humanitarian and economic. One of the issues that needs wide discussion is the interoperability of Blockchain technology, both between the individual crypto projects and the ability to integrate and communicate with existing information systems of companies. The interoperability study is necessary due to the fact that the migration to a new information system is associated with high costs related to the development, implementation and training of employees. It is for this reason that it is appropriate to analyze the prerequisites for interoperability between existing information systems and the ability to communicate through blockchain architectures.

articleTitle: An Overview of Security and Risk Management in Business Intelligence Systems
publicationTitle: 2020 III International Conference on High Technology for Sustainable Development (HiTech)
abstract: In modern business taking right and tamely decisions is of great importance. Business intelligence systems substantially ease the taking of management decisions which are based on analyzed, timely and accurate information. Providing security and risk management is of critical importance. This article presents some of the most frequently used systems that help in taking business decisions as well as a few ISO standards that provide the so important security and risk management in the used business analytical systems.

articleTitle: Development of a MIDI Synthesizer for Test Signals to a Wireless Acoustic Sensor Network
publicationTitle: 2020 III International Conference on High Technology for Sustainable Development (HiTech)
abstract: There are two main types of devices that generate MIDI data: MIDI musical instruments and MIDI controllers. MIDI musical instruments, also known as synthesizers, are available in all different shapes and sizes. Their main feature, or what sets them apart from MIDI controllers, is that they generate both audio and MIDI data. These synthesizers can be integrated into scientific experiment to generate acoustic signals to test the functionality of a wireless acoustic sensor network.

articleTitle: Research on Logistics Relevance for SMEs in Context of Organization Size, Costs and Outsourcing Level
publicationTitle: 2020 III International Conference on High Technology for Sustainable Development (HiTech)
abstract: The main objective of this research is to empirically verify working hypotheses on logistics role in the SMEs context. The survey was conducted among small and medium-sized business units in Bulgaria. The statistical calculations demonstrated that the conducted testing methodology is reliable in terms of selected variables and conceptual model. The main analysis factors were properly evaluated and indicate validity for further research. The tests evidenced that the developed linear regression model is statistically significant and it can be used to evaluate the influence of the analysis factors on role and relevance of the logistics for Bulgarian SMEs.

articleTitle: Methodology of Evaluation Effectiveness of E-Platforms for Business Meetings
publicationTitle: 2020 III International Conference on High Technology for Sustainable Development (HiTech)
abstract: Today's business world is changing rapidly due to the measures taken as an attempt to reduce the consequences of the pandemic caused by COVID-19 virus. Business traditions established for many years now are unable to deal effectively with the seriousness and complexity of the situation. Working in totally different conditions where the social isolation is absolutely requested imposes other methods of professional communication - indirect trough the various technological solutions. Therefore e-platforms for business meetings are becoming extremely popular as one of the working options for business meetings. The present paper develops special methodology for evaluation the effectiveness of available e-platforms used for business meetings. Proposed methodology could be used both from practitioners and scholars in order to help them in the decision process of e-platform selection according to the concrete business purpose, type of participants and type of meeting.

articleTitle: Indicators for Effectiveness and Efficiency of E-Platforms for Business Meetings
publicationTitle: 2020 III International Conference on High Technology for Sustainable Development (HiTech)
abstract: Due to the measures taken as precautions in fight against COVID-19 virus in a global scale, as well as social isolation requirements, different online tools for videoconference are becoming more and more popular. As a result of the sever business environment companies struggle to survive and one of the possible solutions is to convert business processes and to implement as much as possible from direct to online work and contribution. The technological progress, especially in the field of ICT offers managers on different levels of hierarchy a variety of already developed tools for online communication, with almost all specifics of the real direct communication. The purpose of the present paper is to identify and to explain the important indicators with help of which the effectiveness and efficiency of one e-platform for business meeting could be determined. Once developed these indicators, they could be in use both in the daily work of the managers and researchers whose scientific interest is focused in the field of e-business meetings and videoconferences.

articleTitle: Acoustic Sensor Network for Acoustic Measurements in Closed Rooms
publicationTitle: 2020 III International Conference on High Technology for Sustainable Development (HiTech)
abstract: Due to the ever-increasing processing power of the acoustic nodes, Wireless Acoustic Sensor Networks (WASNs) are being assign more complicated and computationally demanding tasks. Recent research has started to exploit this increased processing power in order for the WSNs to perform tasks pertaining to audio signal acquisition and processing forming so-called wireless acoustic sensor networks (WASNs). Wireless acoustic sensor networks are a next-generation technology for audio acquisition and processing. In order for WASNs to cope with these increased demands, it is incontrovertibly apparent that efficient algorithms need to be develop. These algorithms must not only be computationally efficient but must also take into consideration several network wide design constraints in order efficiently allocate the limited resources of the nodes. The main aim of this article is, therefore, to incorporate these constraints into the design of Acoustic Sensor Network for Acoustic Measurements in Closed Rooms.

articleTitle: Thermographic Analysis of Disk Brake System During Chassis Dynamometer Test
publicationTitle: 2020 III International Conference on High Technology for Sustainable Development (HiTech)
abstract: In this article, we present a thermographic investigation of the disk brake system of a passenger vehicle. In a controlled environment, we obtained a sequence of images in a laboratory at TU-Sofia. Our selection of image arrays and points is founded on the analysis of the distribution of temperature fields. We have considered the potentialities to apply this type of analysis in chassis dynamometer tests and implement it in smart vehicle applications.

articleTitle: An Application Model that Leverages Microservice and Blockchain Technologies
publicationTitle: 2020 III International Conference on High Technology for Sustainable Development (HiTech)
abstract: In the last few years, blockchain technologies and microservices have been especially popular for developing web applications. This paper aims to offer a model for creating applications based on blockchain technologies and microservices. The proposed model belongs to the hybrid models using both centralized and decentralized model. An analysis of the separate technologies is proposed, assessing their advantages and disadvantages. Based on this analysis, an example model of an online store has been developed, as a typical representative of microservice architecture. This model can be used to create any application according to the developed template.

articleTitle: E-commerce, as a Modulating Possibility for Application of the Drop-shipping Model
publicationTitle: 2020 III International Conference on High Technology for Sustainable Development (HiTech)
abstract: With the increasing penetration of the Internet, e-commerce and digital marketing in the traditional supply chain, there is an increasing interest among entrepreneurs to use a more up-to-date and modern business model, known as drop-shipping. The purpose of the article is to analyse the characteristics and impact of the drop-shipping model as an evolutionary form of the traditional supply chain model. There are broad prospects for both small and medium-sized enterprises (SMEs) and sole traders, as well as for diversified goods producers, in the context of easier and more flexible entry and entry into stable global market positions. The study outlines the opportunities and prospects for the development of the drop-shipping model, which should be further researched.

articleTitle: Search Correspondence Between the Roles of the Brainstorming Participants and Belbin's Team Roles
publicationTitle: 2020 III International Conference on High Technology for Sustainable Development (HiTech)
abstract: In the paper presented the method of brainstorming with some examples is presented and the main requirements to the moderator, discussion participants and critics have been analyzed. The correspondence between the performing roles of the participants in the brainstorming session and the team roles of Belbin was determined. The procedure of brainstorming session with participants who are ideally suited for Belbin's team roles is described. An experiment was carried out with students performing a course project on machine elements using the developed method. The experiment showed the greater efficiency of the project teams, formed in accordance with the Belbin methodology and performing brainstorming in accordance with the developed recommendations.

articleTitle: Entrepreneurial Intentions Research of Business Students in the Ukrainian Context
publicationTitle: 2020 III International Conference on High Technology for Sustainable Development (HiTech)
abstract: The goal of the current paper is to empirically check the ideas of the TPB in the Ukrainian academic context. The research was carried out among students in the undergraduate business programs of NUBIP, Ukraine. The statistical estimations demonstrated that the independent factors such as attitude towards entrepreneurship, subjective norms, locus of control and self-efficacy influence business students entrepreneurial intentions. The main behavioral factors extracted through factor analysis are fully consistent with those of the Ajzen's theoretical concept and they have sufficient validity in the Ukrainian context. The tests verified the proposed linear regression model is statistically significant and it can be implemented to predict the impact of the main behavioral factors on the entrepreneurial intentions of the Ukrainian business students.

articleTitle: Obtaining of Activated Carbon Adsorbents Based on Wood Waste Material via Chemical Activation
publicationTitle: 2020 III International Conference on High Technology for Sustainable Development (HiTech)
abstract: The paper investigates the possibility of producing a cost-effective activated carbon (AC) from lignocellulosic waste biomass, whose application is most often as an adsorbent removal of impurities and toxic substances from liquid and gas phases. A two stage laboratory technology was used for this purpose - carbonization and chemical activation with potassium hydroxide. The obtained AC samples were characterized using Elemental composition analysis, Fourier transform infrared spectroscopy (FTIR), SEM and Specific surface area analyzer, using Brunauer-Emmett-Teller (BET) analysis. The obtained results show achieving good characteristics of the obtained adsorbing materials.

articleTitle: MATLAB Optimization of Boost DC-DC Converter
publicationTitle: 2020 III International Conference on High Technology for Sustainable Development (HiTech)
abstract: In this research a MATLAB optimization of a boost converter is proposed. With the aid of the mathematical model created by the methodology of switching function is executed an optimization procedure with main purpose precise definition of the designed value of the passive components. The purpose of this research is to obtained aperiodic transient process in the output of the converter. This facilitates control synthesis and facilitates the setting of the controller coefficients. The specific implementation was done with the help of tools that are created in the MATLAB/ Simulink environment, which is very useful in view of the use of the proposed procedure by non-specialists in mathematics. On the other hand, as a result of the optimization, the transient time in the power circuit is shortened, which significantly improves its dynamics.

articleTitle: Estimation of Energy Performance Classes of Concrete Structures with Artificial Intelligence Models
publicationTitle: 2020 III International Conference on High Technology for Sustainable Development (HiTech)
abstract: The construction sector is one of the sectors that make energy efficiency a must. In almost every field related to the construction sector, there is a need for studies in which high performance can be achieved by including artificial intelligence in energy. In this study, energy class models, which are an area of artificial intelligence, which show the efficiency level of energy systems that determine the energy performance of buildings, are examined.

articleTitle: Reliability Estimation Using Mission Profile of High Frequency Power Supply for Soldering Carbide Tips
publicationTitle: 2020 III International Conference on High Technology for Sustainable Development (HiTech)
abstract: The paper considers the reliability of HF power supply used for induction heating of steel pieces in the manufacturing of carbide tips. The reliability estimation of these types of power convertors is a complex task. The power supply operates with different: types of inductors, production schedules, environmental conditions and temperatures of the water cooling system. To estimate the reliability, it is necessary to define the so-called “mission profile” of the power supply according to the currently defined operating conditions. In this case the reliability for this type of application of the power supply can be estimated accurately with operational reliability. It is necessary to consider methods and methodologies that provide models for mission profile reliability estimation.

articleTitle: Modelling of DC-DC Converter for Charging of Energy Storage Devices
publicationTitle: 2020 III International Conference on High Technology for Sustainable Development (HiTech)
abstract: In the current research a mathematical model of DC-DC converter charging an energy storage devices is presented. The model of the converter is realized in MATLAB/Simulink. For energy storage devices is used a supercapacitor.

articleTitle: Influence of the Cooling Conditions on the Heating of a Power Distribution Block
publicationTitle: 2020 III International Conference on High Technology for Sustainable Development (HiTech)
abstract: This paper studies the influence of the cooling conditions on the heating of a low voltage power distribution block (PDB) of terminals. The heating of the PDB has been considered in the following cases: closed PDB and consideration of the thermodynamic processes in it and heat transfer toward the environment by means of radiation and convection; open power distribution block (without cover) and heat transfer to the surroundings through radiation and convection; terminal block with ventilation openings on its cover and consideration of the thermodynamic processes in the block, heat transfer to the environment through radiation and convection. The study has been conducted using computer models elaborated in the software product COMSOL. The related problem “electric field - thermal field - fluid field” has been solved. A juxtaposition of the acquired numerical results has been made.

articleTitle: Deep Learning Platforms for High-Performance and Distributed Computing Object Detection
publicationTitle: 2020 III International Conference on High Technology for Sustainable Development (HiTech)
abstract: Deep learning developed in the last decade and has been established as recent, modern and very promising technique with large potential to be successfully applied in various domains. Despite deep learning outperforms alternative techniques in providing solution to many different problems there are several concerns and limitations of the its usage, one of them being the computational complexity of the training process. The paper discusses the possibilities of taking advantage of high-performance and distributed computing for efficiently and effectively training deep learning models for computer vision applications. A comparison of deep learning platforms and frameworks utilized on high-performance computer systems is presented and their application for computer vision problem of object detection is evaluated based on a suggested parallel computation architectural model and utilization of RetinaNet model.

articleTitle: Network of Autonomous Energy Storage Modules, Such as Concentrators for Charging Stations for Electric Vehicles and Smart Sities, Based on Battery Systems and a Model for Selecting the Capacity of Batteries
publicationTitle: 2020 III International Conference on High Technology for Sustainable Development (HiTech)
abstract: The article reports questions, in correlation to the choice of rechargeable batteries for autonomous photovoltaic systems for transport purposes, based on solar radiation in a given area and necessary to meet the need to select a period of time. Concentration of energy in energy storage makes it possible to build off-grid installations, home autonomous systems, common conventional gas stations that can be used as charging stations for electric vehicles, incl. and electric trucks and is a great example of considering “green power” in freight, civil and domestic transport (warehouses, logistics bases, manufacturing). A completely new aspect of energy storage, which has been discussed recently, but may play an important role in the near future, is the storage of electricity in batteries, incl. and electric cars. The idea is that car batteries will generally be charged at night, and if an intelligent distribution network is implemented, the charging cycle itself can be controlled centrally or by neural networks.

articleTitle: Energy Harvesting Measurement of Sonic Crystal Acoustic Barrier
publicationTitle: 2020 III International Conference on High Technology for Sustainable Development (HiTech)
abstract: The presented article examines a new type of Sonic Crystal noise barrier and the possibility of collecting energy generated by noise. After COMSOL modelling and various experiments performed in our previous articles, we have determined the best location of the piezo materials used for energy harvesting. The aim of the article is to verify the designed model, to quantify the collected energy and to analyse the efficiency of energy harvesting in noise reduction.

articleTitle: Contract Management Issues in System Integration Projects
publicationTitle: 2020 III International Conference on High Technology for Sustainable Development (HiTech)
abstract: This paper presents the specifics of Project Management (PM) during System Integration (SI) projects implementation. The problems that appear during SI projects implementation come across on the way of dealing with the subcontractors, as they need to meet the quality criteria provided by the client. The PM team on the other hand needs to very well understand the project requirements, constraints and other existing variables, and up to them to define the limits acceptable variations for conducting business under contract. Meaning that, all stakeholders have the same understandings on those definitions. But, the different stakeholders come form different industries and in many times they need to created those common understandings. In many cases the misunderstandings left projects underperforming, and those projects often represent those with highest priority for the client. Thus, we need to be proactive and open the discussion on what the common understandings bring to the project implementation, and focus on them.

articleTitle: Influence of the Cables on the Heating of a Power Distribution Block
publicationTitle: 2020 III International Conference on High Technology for Sustainable Development (HiTech)
abstract: The paper aims at presenting the results from numerical studies of the heating in a low-voltage power distribution block. The studies have been conducted with different lengths of the connecting cables, along which the heat flow, generated by external losses, propagates. The external losses can be due to: power losses in the current-carrying elements of switching devices, connected to the circuit of a power distribution block; increased contact resistance in the circuit of the power distribution block etc. Therefore a 3D computer model of the power distribution block in COMSOL has been developed. The constructive peculiarities of the block have been taken into account and the coupled electric field-thermal field-fluid dynamics problem has been solved. Results have been obtained, concerning the influence of the cable lengths on the heating in the power distribution block at different values of external losses both for copper and for aluminum cables.

articleTitle: Studying Supercapacitor Reliability according to Operating Modes and Environmental Conditions
publicationTitle: 2020 III International Conference on High Technology for Sustainable Development (HiTech)
abstract: Supercapacitors can be viewed as energy storage devices. Like every component in the electronic circuitry, they can cause failures in electronic equipment and therefore are subject of reliability studies. The main factors affecting supercapacitor reliability are operating temperature, operating voltage and equivalent series resistance (ESR). Those three performance parameters of supercapacitors should be embedded in the model for calculating parameters such as failure rates, mean time to failure and reliability.

articleTitle: Environmental Aspects of Economic Issues Associated with the Factors of Production
publicationTitle: 2020 III International Conference on High Technology for Sustainable Development (HiTech)
abstract: Nature cannot be considered anymore as one of the factors of production. The reasons are observed air pollution, congestion of water basins, soil pollution. While it is difficult to draw boundaries between the business and the environment, this article is discussed bidirectional dependence “environment - enterprise - environment” like the emphasis is on the chemical technologies and comical production. It is considered that though the complex impact on the factors of production, as an effect of developed environmental strategy, it could be achieved significant greening of production. It also describes how changes in economic conditions, including for environmental reasons, affect an entity's financial performance through factors of production.

articleTitle: Preparation and Characterization of Activated Carbon Derived from Lignocellulosic Waste Biomass
publicationTitle: 2020 III International Conference on High Technology for Sustainable Development (HiTech)
abstract: The study reports the use of wood waste biomass to obtain activated carbons. Lignocellulosic materials used as precursors are pine and beech sawdust, which is an industrial residue. Carbonization and subsequent chemical activation with potassium hydroxide (KOH) at 600 °C was done to develop high surface area. The produced AC samples were characterized for their physical and chemical properties using Scanning Electron Microscopy (SEM), Elemental composition analysis, Fourier transform infrared spectroscopy (FTIR) and Brunauer-Emmett-Teller (BET) surface area analysis. The results obtained show the activated carbons prepared have a very high specific surface area (from 1200 to 1600 m<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup>g<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">-1</sup>) and high microporous volume (about 0.500 cm<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</sup>g<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">-1</sup>). These characteristics are a prerequisite for the obtained AC to be used as adsorbents in the removal of toxic pollutants from the environment.

articleTitle: Entrepreneurial Intentions Research of Business Students in the Bulgarian Context
publicationTitle: 2020 III International Conference on High Technology for Sustainable Development (HiTech)
abstract: The main goal of this research is to empirically verify Ajzen's TPB in the Bulgarian academic context. The survey was conducted among business students in the undergraduate programs of Prof. Ass. Zlatarov University – Burgas. The statistical calculations proved that the four behavioural variables, such as locus of control, subjective norms, attitude towards entrepreneurship and self-efficacy impact on the entrepreneurial intentions of the business students. The main behavioral factors derived through factor analysis are fully covered by those established in the theoretical concepts. The tests evidenced the developed linear regression model is statistically significant and it can be used to evaluate the influence of the behavioral variables on the entrepreneurial intentions of the Bulgarian business students.

articleTitle: Prediction of the Thermo-Mechanical Behavior of a Sliding Isolator Based on Finite Element and Analytical Analysis
publicationTitle: 2020 III International Conference on High Technology for Sustainable Development (HiTech)
abstract: This contribution focuses on the analytical and finite element modelling of the thermo-mechanical behaviour of a friction-pendulum bearing device for passive seismic isolation. Influences of some crucial factors, such as the magnitude and the rate of change of the sliding velocity, the weight of the superstructure, and the rise in temperature on the force-displacement relationship characterizing the isolator, are studied. Numerical results obtained for a realistic testing protocol (plausible value of the applied normal force and sliding velocity) are presented.

articleTitle: Industry 4.0 and Next Normality in Ensuring Sustainable Development
publicationTitle: 2020 III International Conference on High Technology for Sustainable Development (HiTech)
abstract: In the research, information about the features of the development of the world's economies based on Next Normality and Industry 4.0 is given. The prerequisites for stimulating the transition of national economies to the principles of Next Normality are revealed. This will ensure the sustainable development of society in overcoming the new global economic crisis. The use of Industry 4.0 technologies (Cloud Technologies, Artificial Intelligence and others) for processing big data and creating forecasts at different levels: the world, countries, enterprises, equipment operation and others was justified. Reasonable recommendations for the development of the national economy of Ukraine based on Industry 4.0 in the context of Next Normality are offered.

articleTitle: Preparation and Application of Composite Material as Sorbent for Oil Spills
publicationTitle: 2020 III International Conference on High Technology for Sustainable Development (HiTech)
abstract: Oil spills are a serious environmental, economic and social problem. The use of sorbents derived from different materials is considered to be the most effective method for their removal. In this study, we obtained novel sorbent materials based on natural products: textile material made of cotton and modified with chitosan crosslinked with glutaraldehyde and in situ obtained ZnO particles. These composite materials have good sorption properties and are easy and effective to use and they remove crude oil and oil products contaminants in water. Their reusability has also been investigated.

articleTitle: A Brief Overview of the Some Forecasting Methods in Energetics
publicationTitle: 2020 III International Conference on High Technology for Sustainable Development (HiTech)
abstract: The planning of energy production and consumption is of great importance for providing both a sustainable economic growth and a clean environment. Accurate short-term forecast in the energy sector is a necessary condition for meeting the energy needs and making long-term strategies for developing the energy capacities and policies. The choice of forecasting model is based primarily on the availability of data. The fundamental provision of efficient forecasting models is based on load balancing, energy trade and network integration. This research presents a brief overview of the mainly applied forecasting methodologies as a set of physical and mathematical models and artificial intelligence in the last twenty years.

articleTitle: Study of the Main Scenarios for Bulgarian Energy System Development
publicationTitle: 2020 III International Conference on High Technology for Sustainable Development (HiTech)
abstract: This article presents results, analyses and financial value assessments obtained as a result of modeling the two scenarios - WEM and WAM from Integrated National Plan in the field of energy and climate of Republic of Bulgaria with widely-used software tool LEAP (the Low Emissions Analysis Platform). We compared our results with the ones of the consultants Deloitte and E3-Modelling that have performed the modeling for the plan. Finally, we give some analyses and conclusions.
